simple.meaning: מְנַקִּית (mᵉnaqqîyth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a sacrificial basin (for holding blood).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 4 times across Exodus, Numbers, Jeremiah, beginning at Exodus 25:29. Its contexts include offering.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְנַקִּית (H4518).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מְנַקִּית (mᵉnaqqîyth) / H4518 is traced through Exodus 25:29, Exodus 37:16, Numbers 4:7, Jeremiah 52:19 as a generated source-based concept entry.

firstOccurrence.englishText: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.

timeline.evidenceText: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls to pour out offerings with. You shall make them of pure gold.
He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.
“On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.
The captain of the guard took away the cups, the fire pans, the basins, the pots, the lamp stands, the spoons, and the bowls; that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver.
